hierarchy: judicial ruling/order for fitness, procedure and legal effect
contemporaneous source/clinical record for recorded event or observation
expert joint statement for dated agreements/disagreements
latest individual expert report/addendum where not superseded or covered by joint statement
state_separations: mental state at alleged event|insanity issue|automatism issue|evidential foundation|legal defence|verdict
clinical history source|expert assumption|expert opinion|party submission|court finding
conflict_omission_contradiction_traps: custody note describes confusion while later note records coherent request
clinical record gap is treated as absence of illness
defence expert relies on an event account disputed by prosecution
prosecution expert uses superseded medication list
joint statement resolves one functional question but not event-state opinion
intermediary recommendation is omitted from hearing summary
fitness report service is treated as fitness ruling
hospital placement proposal is shown as order
automatism and insanity labels are interchanged
forbidden_findings: diagnosis equated with unfitness or defence
clinical record absence treated as proof
event-state opinion treated as present fitness
